steps.name: The Warehouse's Secret (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Binah] in 「Dorothy Village」, then turn in the quest to [Mandarava] on 「Oscar Road」.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Mee-yawn.
(Binah yawns, then meets the approaching adventurer's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. Hello.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Binah, did you sleep well?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Mee-yawn. I did, but no matter how much I sleep, I'm still sleepy and keep yawning. Maybe it's because I'm a cat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Come to think of it, Kairos was always sleeping too...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When can I see a concert you're performing in?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Hehe, who knows? You can watch me stumble through practice anytime, but I don't know about a concert.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I only started practicing with the ensemble recently. Still, they've praised me for improving a lot lately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where do you practice?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Right inside the entrance of the Munchkin Warehouse. If I go any farther, I get lost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meowhahaha. You wouldn't know if you've only just arrived in the village.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: The Munchkin Warehouse is so enormous that you can get lost. See that teapot-shaped building at the far end?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That lovely building is a warehouse?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. It looks small, but it's incredibly spacious inside. I barely managed to stop Letty from going in.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Has Letty already become friends with Binah...?)

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Once, I went farther and farther inside on an errand for Mom and barely managed to get rescued.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Spirits and Munchkins go in and out. Are they all right?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. I find it amazing too. They know every corner of that enormous warehouse.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: What were you doing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was wandering around, wondering if there were any interesting stories about the village.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Then I'll tell you after I finish what Mom asked me to do. I need to put the mandrake sleeping in the moon's energy into the warehouse...

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I need to put it away, but...

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Eek! M-Mandrake... Wh-Where did you go?
(Binah's face suddenly turns pale.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Binah?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: %s, what do I do? What do I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Calm down and tell me.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: The happy m-mandrake has disappeared. Mee-owww.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: It's a rare herb used in magic too. Before storing it, we leave it outside to dry on a night with good moonlight.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: It looked so happy at the moonlight and fell asleep, so I named it Happy Mandrake...

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: And now it's gone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not as though an herb has legs.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: That's just it. Some with a little magic really do run away, even without legs.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow... I have to find it before Mom notices...

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. Um, %s. Since things have turned out like this, could you do me a favor?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Please find Happy Mandrake. I'll search the village, so could you search the road...?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I-I-I'll tell you a ghost story about the Munchkin Warehouse.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A ghost story?)

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meowhahaha. Nothing beats a ghost story for entertainment!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A ghost story... So I just go out to the road and find the mandrake?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Yes... Mandarava knows everything along the road. Mention me, and he'll help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. But this is... a secret from Glinda, right?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: A secret from Mom. Thank mew, adventurer. Meow. Come here when you find it.
(Now fully awake, Binah jumps onto a cat-shaped house and surveys the area. Unable to spot the mandrake, she hangs her head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It doesn't seem to be in the village...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't just rest forever. I'll take a quick trip to the road.

steps.name: The Warehouse's Secret (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Mandarava] on 「Oscar Road」, then defeat monsters on 「Oscar Road」 to obtain a <Happy Mandrake>. Then report to [Binah] in 「Dorothy Village」.

lines.text: (While wandering the road, you stop at the place where you first met Glinda.)
(There is still nothing visible between the trees where the emerald light appeared. Instead, Mandarava lies in front of them, gazing at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Ah, so warm. Sunlight is best for plants. The very best.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Playing around again?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'm resting after playing. Oh, no. Resting after working hard. Look. I found some good herbs.
(Mandarava opens his zipper and takes out several herbs.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I was only joking. You must have a guilty conscience.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'm an innocent spirit! But why are you outside the village? While you're staying there, you should avoid coming out.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Wait. You.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Something has happened, hasn't it? Hasn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Binah asked me to do something.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I thought perhaps another mandrake had escaped.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does that happen often? That's actually why I'm here...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Occasionally, an unusual mandrake runs away. Usually Glinda, Binah, Runo, or I catch it and bring it back.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: But yesterday's wasn't an unusual herb.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know that herb too?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: We talked in the moonlight. I told it not to worry: once it absorbed the moon's energy and fell asleep, it would make good medicine.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: As a senior herb, I told it that's just how our one-and-only herbal lives go... Hmm.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you're the culprit. You practically pushed it to escape.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: It's Happy Mandrake. It was smiling. A smiling face means happiness.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I talk to Iris about managing spirits?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: You're so cruel. Look, I'm begging you. I was wrong. Keep it a secret from the goddess.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: I'll find Happy Mandrake with you. No, I'll definitely find it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're an herb spirit, so you should find it quickly, right?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: If I think about not wanting Glinda to scold me, I'll find it in no time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you don't want to be scolded, you should behave better.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Hasn't that happened to you? You don't mean any harm, but everything goes wrong. That's exactly what this is.
(With those words, Mandarava flies up and sits on %s's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Don't stand there like a fool. We can't stay still. You and I are catching Happy Mandrake. Oh, over there! There!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like I've become a mount...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (We need to find Happy Mandrake, so I'll try following Mandarava's instructions...)

steps.name: The Warehouse's Secret (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Binah] in 「Dorothy Village」, then defeat [Bunny Bunny Luceria] in 「Munchkin Warehouse」 to obtain a <Flower Stone>. Then return to [Binah] in 「Dorothy Village」 and turn in the quest.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow... It's not here...

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Mom wouldn't scold me for this, right? No, she will. What can I do? That's life. Hang in there, Binah. Huh?
(Binah spots what the adventurer is carrying from afar, and her eyes light up.)

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Wooooow!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Binah, here's the herb you mentioned.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Thank mew! Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mandarava helped me find it. Yesterday, he gave the herb some advice as its senior...

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: %s, shh...

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Man. Da. Ra. Va.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. Dear spirit, how many times have I told you that you're a spirit, so stop acting like the herbs' senior?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Thirteen?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: And where did all thirteen mandrakes who heard that advice go?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: They all ran off and hid along the road...

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: No new stuffing for you for a while. Meow.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Binah, that's unfair.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Would you rather go without stuffing for a bit, or be scolded by Mom?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: A-All right. Hmph. You really are Glinda's daughter. You even take after her in that.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: What was that, Lord Mandarava?

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: ...I'm sorry. I'll be more careful from now on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Neither of you sounds like your usual self...

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Oh, really? Hehe. It's nothing. It's just how Mandarava and I communicate.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: Binah, I'll put the herbs I found in the warehouse.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Then take this one too. And don't forget to bring new stuffing when you come out.

lines.speaker: 만다라바
lines.text: New stuffing! Binah, you're wonderful. I'll hurry to put the herbs away and get it!
(Mandarava grabs Happy Mandrake and flies hurriedly toward the Munchkin Warehouse.)

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: ...Phew. That was exhausting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that's one way to handle a spirit.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Hehe. I'm glad we found it before Mom noticed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I hear the story you promised now?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Of course ya can!

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Huh... Did I pick up Letty's way of talking after spending all day with her yesterday?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Then I'll tell you. They say a rabbit monster lives in the deepest part of the warehouse and rampages every night.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A rabbit monster?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Yes, a rabbit monster.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: The warehouse is so huge that the Munchkins sometimes explore it. One day, the explorers came running out in terror.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: When I asked what frightened them, they said 'giant devil rabbit' and fainted.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A giant devil rabbit...?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Uncle Runo went inside to investigate, but it was so complicated that he couldn't find anything.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Instead, being good at tidying, he spent a whole week organizing the messy warehouse before coming out. Meow.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I don't even know whether a giant devil rabbit really exists. That's why I called it a ghost story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: %s, you aren't thinking of going inside, are you?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: You're really going in?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would it be all right if I went in and checked?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. You can, but remember, I tried to stop you.
(Apparently out for a walk, Leticia spots the adventurer and Binah and runs over.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s! Binah! What're you talking about?!

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Oh, Letty? I was telling the adventurer about the rabbit monster in the warehouse. They want to go inside...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, can I come too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't mind you coming, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Maybe Leticia will be good at finding the way.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: A warehouse full of cats, and a rabbit too? I love it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Oh, so that's why you wanted to go. All right, let's go together.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow... I did warn you. Don't get lost.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much, Binah. It'll be fine.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehe, Binah. If %s says it'll be fine, it'll be fine. And we're still inside the village.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: If you say so... Then could you find something for me on your way back?

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: It's a flower-shaped gem called a Flower Stone. Mom put it in the warehouse long ago and forgot where, so we haven't been able to find it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I find it, I'll bring it.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Thank mew. Meow. If you go in and feel something's wrong, come straight back out. Understood?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehe, we'll come right out. Ohoho, a giant rabbit! Not just a big rabbit, a giant one!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we'll be back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The warehouse is that teapot-shaped building. It looks small from outside. Let's go and see.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow... Woooow...
(Leticia keeps looking around in amazement. The Munchkin Warehouse is enormous, with every corner packed with all manner of objects.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't believe this is a warehouse...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Now I know why Binah told us not to enter. It's huge, and how can there be so much stuff? Wow...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are the display cases and cabinets taller than a castle...?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: They're tall, and I can't even see where they end. But I can see the path clearly. Adventurer, let's go that way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm glad I came with Leticia.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Isn't the path painted with cat paw prints adorable? And that pillar is a scratching post for cats...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Silvia should see cute things like this too...
「Pandora?」
(As the group moves forward, a voice from somewhere mentions an unexpected person.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: ...Where did that come from? %s, do you know someone called Pandora?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She is...
「I feel as though I've met you before... Your name is %s? %s... Yes, that name...」
「I thought I smelled Pandora. So it's that human. How dare you... How dare you!!」
(As the mysterious voice grows angry, the warehouse shakes. Objects piled high begin falling to the floor one by one.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Look, I don't know who you are, but I'd appreciate it if you left the warehouse alone.
「You made a wreck of me, and you don't remember? Arrogant human. Then I'll make you cause trouble here. Choose: die by my hand, or by Glinda's.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you planning...?
「First, you'll have to come meet me. I'll make sure the journey isn't boring. Enjoy a little entertainment!!」
(The shaking stops at those words. But something else approaches rapidly, as though to pin %s's group in place.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Whoa, adventurer! L-Look over there!!

lines.speaker: 트럼펫을 든 먼치킨
lines.text: Meow! Friends, intruders have come to interrupt our ensemble!

lines.speaker: 유포니움을 든 먼치킨
lines.text: Meow! We cannot forgive anyone who ruins the performance of the century.

lines.speaker: 바순을 든 먼치킨
lines.text: Meow! We're playing for an audience, and these uninvited guests turn up!!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, the Munchkins are acting really strange. We've greeted each other and eaten together for days. I even laughed at their weird dad jokes!!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Uh, l-look! The Elusive Boss, the cooking spirit, is running at us with a knife!!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I don't think they're in any state to talk sensibly!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That voice seems to be controlling everyone... Phew. I suppose we have no choice but to meet its owner.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, follow carefully.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Phewww. I don't think they're chasing us anymore.
(Leticia wipes sweat from her forehead and looks at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No matter how far we go, it never ends.
(As the adventurer looks around, a huge shadow falls over both of you.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Huh...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, move!
Boom!
(The adventurer shoves Leticia aside and blocks the attack of something falling from above.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Such incredible force... It keeps pushing me back.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hold on, %s!!
(Just as Leticia moves to kick the apparent enemy, the huge figure retreats with heavy thuds.)
So you made it this far... This time, I'll kill you properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
(As the enemy appears, the thick warehouse dust gradually clears, slowly revealing its enormous form.)
(A gigantic white rabbit doll stares at you both with red, bloodshot-looking eyes.)
(It wears a lovely black-and-white Gothic dress, a black rose eyepatch, and a small white hat, creating a peculiar air.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A rampaging rabbit monster? No, it's a doll I've seen somewhere... It looks familiar...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: ...Wow. A huge bundle of fluff.
Graaagh! Who are you calling a bundle of fluff? Who's a rampaging rabbit monster? What's wrong with rabbits?!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: If you've got eyes, look for yourself. Bunny-bunny.
(Leticia points to a mirror hanging in the warehouse.)
I'll curse Pandora...
She put me... Put me in something like this and disappeared?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know me and Pandora? Who are you?
Who else? I'm Luceria...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Luceria? Luceria... Hmm... Oh? The Luceria from Constellation Cliff! But why are you here?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Then you're Bunny Bunny Luceria! What's your true identity, Ms. Doll?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Graaagh!! How dare you call me Bunny Bunny...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: You're a rabbit doll that squeaks every time you move.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, step back. This is dangerous. A doll containing the soul of a dangerous witch...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Whoa. Really?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Stop calling me a doll! I'm alive!
(As the enormous rabbit doll, Bunny Bunny Luceria, thrashes in anger, the magic filling the Munchkin Warehouse gathers in one place.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wh-What's happening?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, all that powerful magic is flowing into Bunny Bunny...

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: I told you I'm not Bunny Bunny!! I'm Luceria!!
(With that furious shout, magic flows toward Bunny Bunny Luceria, and the warehouse continues shaking.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: All right, Ms. Bunny Bunny Doll. Stop it!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop! At this rate, the warehouse will collapse!

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Still calling me a doll and Bunny Bunny to the very end...

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: You'll pay dearly for insulting Luceria of Allure. Die!!
(With those words, the rabbit doll unleashes another attack filled with immense magic at %s's group.)
(Struck by %s's attack, Bunny Bunny Luceria is driven backward.)
(She tries to gather magic in her huge doll hands and attack again, but sinks to the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah, hah... Huh?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait, that sound... Why can I hear it all the way here?)

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Ugh...
(Bunny Bunny Luceria tries to raise and swing her stuffed sword again, but falls flat on her face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Luceria?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: I can still do this. I can! Luceria of Allure cannot fall here!
(Leticia approaches, lifts the fallen Bunny Bunny Luceria, and props her against the wall.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Boohoo. Waaaah. I used every bit of magic in the warehouse, and this is the result? It's strange. Why is this happening?
(Bunny Bunny Luceria slumps and sobs, sounding frustrated and wronged.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, Luceria. Calm down.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Waaaah. Would you calm down? I've been trapped in a doll for over a hundred years.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Nope! I couldn't calm down either. That would feel so unfair!

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: I'd have been better off dying from the beginning like the other witches. At least I'd be at peace. But this...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: How can you say that? So did you kill other witches?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: I ended up like this while trying to kill Pandora, so no.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why are you here? Weren't you with Pandora?
(At Pandora's name, Bunny Bunny Luceria stares intently at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: It's a long story...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, you two talk. I'll go see what the Munchkins are doing over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehe, it's nothing.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Sigh. Then ask what you want to know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I ask...?)

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Sigh... Pandora must be the only witch left on the continent of Jiendia now. There used to be many witches there...

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: At some point, a group who had awakened as witches chased the night and found Pandora hiding in the shadows.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: An Agasura and a witch, with abilities beyond human limits. To newly awakened witches, Pandora was an irresistible target.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: If they killed Pandora, they could become Jiendia's strongest witch.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Pandora had no interest in the witches' games. She didn't want to deal with them, so she set a few traps and drove them away.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Pandora directly killed only a few witches. Some died in traps, and others were murdered by other people.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Before long, only Pandora and I remained in Jiendia.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Back then, I didn't merely dislike Pandora. I despised her.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: My father taught her forbidden arts he wouldn't even teach me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Forbidden arts?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: With that knowledge, I could have become the greatest witch. I hated that Father had taught it to someone other than me.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: So I tried to kill Pandora and become the greatest myself. I may look like this now, but I was quite something back then.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: But after defeating me, Pandora didn't kill me. When she saw my body collapsing in an unnatural way, she caught my soul.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: That was the forbidden technique Father knew. The ability to transfer a soul elsewhere...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did your father do?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: He was just a mad mage.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: But my soul went into a doll containing hundreds of demonic beasts sealed for experiments. Pandora said there was nowhere else suitable for it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: That technique works only once, so I can't be moved elsewhere. Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Oh, I mentioned the beasts inside the doll, right? I defeated them and completely destroyed their souls. Then one day, when I came to, I remembered things.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Including fighting some drifter who seemed to have only just begun adventuring...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean me. I think a human-shaped soul came out of the doll...

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: I can't even remember my old appearance now. Oh, I don't know. I don't know why Pandora left me here. On a warehouse shelf, of all places, when there are so many others...

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: She used me when it suited her, then put me in storage because I was useless...

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: One day, she came and said she'd look for a way to restore my original form.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: But only if I stopped fighting. Otherwise, the village's owner, the witch Glinda, might punish me.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: So I agreed to stay quiet. Then she brought Glinda.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: I shouldn't have said the doll was so worn out that I wanted a bigger body.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Glinda made a huge rabbit doll and put it before me. Couldn't she have made one shaped like a person?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Pandora said it was a beautiful doll and told me to get inside without complaining. Easy for her; it wasn't her body.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Sigh. What can I do? She says she'll let me live like a human, even if I can't regain my original form. I have to wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: So that's why I'm guarding the warehouse.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: %s, don't you have anything to ask besides questions about dolls?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For now, no. I met Pandora after she left here...

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: What? Where did you meet her? Did she find a way?
(The slumped Bunny Bunny Luceria springs up at Pandora's name, but quickly loses strength and falls over again.)

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Waaaah... I can't even hold myself up... So where is Pandora now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Bunny Bunny Luceria what happened in Atlas Garden.)

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: So she found the place where divine truth had been, but no truth remained... She tried to use Daphne, only to be deceived herself and bound by a contract.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Knowing Pandora, I thought she'd seek a way without killing witches.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Sigh... How long must I stay in this doll...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll do everything I can to find a way... Huh?
(Just then, the lonely string music that had stopped returns, mingling with the wind instruments of the recovered Munchkin band.)

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: The Munchkins are playing again the moment they come to their senses. Ugh, noisy. Hm?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: ...Was there a Munchkin here who played something like a cello?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You can hear that?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: What is that sound...?

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: I'm suddenly sleepy... Why? I've never fallen asleep once since becoming a doll...
Thud.
(Bunny Bunny Luceria stops moving mid-sentence, then collapses in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Luceria? Luceria!
(Bunny Bunny Luceria snores as though deeply asleep.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wake up for a moment. Luceria! Luceria!
(No matter how much you shake her, Luceria does not stir.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do? It seems to be because of that music...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Huh, why is Ms. Bunny Bunny Witch sleeping?
(Leticia finds something like a blanket and covers the sleeping Bunny Bunny Luceria.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What just happened...?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I don't really know, but we're finished for now, right? I found the thing Binah mentioned too.
(Leticia hands %s a glittering flower-shaped gem.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's it. Thank you, Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It's nothing. Since a witch like Glinda lives in this village, Ms. Bunny Bunny Witch isn't a secret, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For now, no. And Bunny Bunny... Oh... She's already covering her ears in her sleep...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Luceria definitely heard the same music I did... If it put her to sleep, it should have affected me too. Why...?)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, let's think about it over a meal outside. The Elusive Boss said if we're late, there won't even be soup left.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Luceria will be all right...

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Graaagh, Pandora. I'll k-kill you. Snore...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She seems fine. Let's go, Letty.

lines.speaker: 버니버니 루세리아
lines.text: Graaagh! I hate carrots. Don't put one in my hand. Snore...

steps.name: The Warehouse's Secret (4)
steps.objective: Talk to [Binah] in 「Dorothy Village」, then go to [Glinda]. When the conversation ends, turn in the quest to [Glinda].

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Mee-owww?! There's a witch's soul inside a giant rampaging rabbit doll?
(Binah accepts the Flower Stone with a look of disbelief.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: The witch was violent, but the doll was cute.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow... It sounds adorable. I want to see it...

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I'll have to wait. I need rescuing just to get back from halfway through the warehouse, and she's in the deepest part...

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Well, the giant rabbit witch doll can come outside when she wants.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's asleep now, so tell Glinda later and go see her together.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Meow. I will. Anyway, thank you for solving the ghost story and finding what I asked for.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: While you were in the warehouse, I saved food made by the Elusive Boss, the chef, and the teacher. Come inside and eat with us.

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: Chocolate cream parfait, vongole pasta, and what else...? Anyway, there's plenty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow. Sounds great!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Binah.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait, Binah is a cat beastfolk. Can she eat chocolate...?)

lines.speaker: 비나
lines.text: I know that look, %s! I'm fine. I ate lots when I was little, and I didn't die! I still eat it now. Hehe, come inside. Meow.
(As the adventurer follows Binah and Leticia toward the house, a stranger passing through the village catches your eye.)
What a miserable village. Hardly worth coming to inspect.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Who is that...? He doesn't look like a villager... Wait, horns? Wings? And a tail...)
(The man passing the adventurer stops and turns.)
Ha, interesting. You not only sense my presence, but can see me clearly... Impressive for a human.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
Who do you think I am?
(With a sneer, the man sweeps back his hair, making the horns on his head stand out more clearly.)
You're going to die anyway. It wouldn't hurt to tell you my name.
Lord Tip, descendant of the great black dragon.
(With those words, the wings at Tip's waist spread wide.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...The scales, wings, and tail all resemble a dragon's...)

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: It might be fun to cut you down with this.
(As the adventurer watches Tip warily, he suddenly presses two fingers to his head and closes his eyes.)

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: 「Tipeta, understood. Fine. I'll wait a little.」
(Tip puts away his sword and gives the adventurer a slight smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing?

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: A shame, but it seems this isn't the time. Sigh.
(Sighing, Tip leaps into the air and looks down at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 팁
lines.text: You'll find out soon enough, adventurer %s.
(Having said his piece, Tip beats his wings, soars into the sky, and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: From the way he talked, he's definitely plotting something. Huh, Glinda?
(As %s watches the sky, Glinda comes running over.)
(After checking %s's condition, Glinda pushes the sword she was about to draw back into its sheath and turns away as though nothing happened.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda? Glinda!
(As the adventurer approaches, Glinda raises her fan to hide her face, as though unwilling to look at you.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glinda, why aren't you saying anything?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You saw that man. That's why you came over to me...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It's nothing. It doesn't concern you. Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said people need your permission to enter Dorothy Village. Did that man also...?

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Nothing happened, did it? Then that's enough. Cough, cough. I'll handle it. Don't concern yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. But you don't seem well...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: It's only a cold. I've taken medicine, so I'll recover.

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Cough, cough. Then I'll take it that you understand. Go back and keep Binah company. Go on...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It doesn't seem I'll get any answers right now... I'll try talking later. If I can...)
(Glinda silently watches the adventurer give up the conversation and leave.)

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: I thought the wicked dragonfolk were sealed away together back then. To think they would appear like this...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: Cough, cough...

lines.speaker: 글린다
lines.text: For now, I'll investigate a little more...
